limitations: Single-player prototype; grid-aligned timber set, three construction stories, maximum 128 parts.
Conservative recorded-parent supports: remove dependent pieces before their recorded support, even when alternatives exist.
No stone/metal tiers, building durability, dinosaur structural damage or multiplayer ownership.
Simplified actor and construction collision; no full environment physics.
